piko_meeting.t: Something is sitting on the glider.
Not hiding. Not startled. Simply sitting there, as if it has always belonged.
Where did you come from? Nobody comes up to the Bluff.
(Piko tilts his head. One feathered ear lifts. He does not move.)
Wait. Long ears, white fur... You're the creature in Grandpa's sketches.
You're sitting on my glider, you know.
...Fine. You can come. But if we fall, it's your fault.

launch_ready.t: The compass points straight out past the edge. Into the open sky.
Jump, then hold on and glide. Simple. Probably.

piko_found_wind.t: Piko, your markings are glowing! And that current wasn't there a second ago.

wind_refuses.t: The wind... it just stops. Like it's refusing to go any further.
(Piko's markings glow faintly. He stares into the fog and goes very still.)
Deep in the mist, the shape of an island drifts where no island should be.
Look where the wind refuses to go... Grandpa, what did you find?
